MessageTypeID.description: ISO Message Type Identifier - 0100 for Auths/0120 for Advices/0400 or 0420 for Reversals

PrimaryAccountNumber.description: Primary Account Number - this contains the (Real) Card Number

SystemTraceAuditNumber.description: Number assigned by the message initiator that uniquely identifies a cardholder transaction and all message types that comprise it

MCCMerchantType.description: Card acceptor business code / merchant category code [MCC]

AcquirerCountryCode.description: Acquiring Institution Country Code is the code of the country where the acquiring institution is located

POSEntryMode.description: indicates the method used for PAN entry to initiate a transaction and the PIN entry capabilities

POSConditionCode.description: (Visa only) Code identifying transaction conditions at the point-of-sale or point of service - for MC, refer to F61 fields below

AcquirerInstitutionID.description: Identifies the acquiring institution (for example, merchant bank) or its agent

RetrievalReferenceNumber.description: Reference number supplied by the system retaining the original source document of the transaction and assists in locating that source document or a copy thereof

AuthIDCode.description: Authorization code provided by the issuer when a transaction is approved

ResponseCode.description: Code that defines the response to a request or the message disposition and acknowledgement that a transaction or a message was received

CardAcceptorTerminalID.description: Identifies a terminal at the card acceptor location of acquiring institutions or merchant POS systems

CardAcceptorIDCode.description: Merchant ID to uniquely identify the merchant in a transaction

CardAcceptorNameLocation.description: Name and location of the card acceptor that defines the point of interaction in both local and interchange environments

CurrencyCodeTransaction.description: Local currency of the acquirer or source location of the transaction

CurrencyCodeBilling.description: Currency code used by the issuer to bill the cardholder's account

VisaF44RespSrcReasonCode.description: For Visa STIP advice, contains the response source/reason code that identifies the source of the field 39 response decision

VisaF60TermEntCapab.description: Code identifying the terminal's capability to electronically read account numbers and expiration dates from cards

VisaF60ChipCondCode.description: Code that provides information about fallback transactions, which are initiated from the magnetic-stripe of VSDC cards at VSDC terminals

VisaF60SpclCondIndic.description: Describes selected special conditions at the point-of-sale

VisaF60ChipTxnIndic.description: This code is set by full VSDC data acquirers if they receive a message from the terminal that indicates a chip-based transaction

VisaF60MoToECIndic.description: For mail order or telephone order transactions (field 25 = 08), it identifies the type of mail/telephone order. For e-commerce transactions (field 25 = 59), it identifies the level of security used in an e-commerce transaction over an open network (for example, the Internet)

VisaF123WalletSPId.description: Token requestor ID / Wallet Service Provider ID

VisaF126RecurTxnIndic.description: Visa Recurring Transaction flag (value = R identifies a recurring transaction)

MCF60AdviceReasonCode.description: For Mastercard STIP advice, this field indicates the general purpose of the advice message

MCF61POSTermAtt.description: (POS Terminal Attendance) indicates if the card acceptor is attending the terminal

MCF61POSCHPresence.description: (POS Cardholder Presence) indicates whether the cardholder is present at the point of service and explains the condition if the cardholder is not present. A value of '4' indicates a recurring transaction

MCF61POSCdPresence.description: (POS Card Presence) indicates if the card is present at the point of service

MCF61POSTranStatus.description: (POS Transaction Status) indicates the purpose or status of the request

MCF61POSTranSec.description: (POS Transaction Security) indicates the card acceptor’s confidence in the transaction security level

MCF61POSChActTermLvl.description: (Cardholder-Activated Terminal Level) indicates the type of cardholder activated terminal used by the cardholder to initiate the transaction

MCF61POSCountryCode.description: (POS Country Code) indicates the country of the POS location (not the acquirer location) using ISO-specified codes
